reviews.title: Perfect support from Abhilash. Many thanks to all
reviews.text: Perfect support from Abhilash. Many thanks to all.. Perfect flight, excellent service, all the best, keep it up
reviews.author: Olaf G

reviews.title: Terrible experience, unresponsive complaints process
reviews.text: Our flight originally at 9.30 am, then 9.50 am was put forward by around 2 hours and after two further changes to 8 am, then finalized at 07.45 am. The recommended time for Kathmandu airport arrival is three hours prior to check in. This was quite literally terrible for us, as it required us to try to get across Kathmandu at 4 am, when there are no busses, taxi apps are unhelpful and unreliable. It meant getting up at 3 am, hoping the transport worked out as there are few alternatives if the taxi does not come, and added an exhausting three hours to our journey Indeed we met another elderly lady on the flight who had been visiting her daughter in Kathmandu, working for a large NGO, who had similar terrible issues with Qatar Airways. We had relied on Qatar Airways as I needed to be back for work, onward transport was pre booked and other times and dates would not work for us in terms of making the connection in Doha or our pre booked transport in UK. From then on our week was a nightmare of trying to contact Qatar Airlines to see what we could do. The app kept asking me to update my details then saying error, as did the web. "Chat" was impossible for us to contact for all the week apart from the last day. It simply didn’t come up. We tried by any means by app, by ipad, by iphone, by laptop. E-mails even to named customer or booking representatives were not answered. We were exhorted by the app to add our trip to privilege club section but this never saved. Our details did not update on the app, yet we were constantly asked to update them. We became used to seeing the message from Qatar Airways; "We are facing some technical error”. There was a constant cycle of being taken back to the home page. My son-in- law, who was with us on the family visit, and very web and app able, after several hours and indeed days of trying, through various different maneuvers, managed to access the chat system. As we were going to be totally exhausted I asked about upgrades or upgrade offers to be told I had been sent an upgrade offer but hadn’t responded, the offer had disappeared and none was now available. This was not true. I had not been sent one. My son-in-law, on the other hand, had received repeated push notifications. We went into a travel agent in Kathmandu and asked them to contact the Qatar Airlines office and explain the situation on our behalf. There were no upgrade offers available. The price would have been equivalent to choosing business or even first class on initial booking. I finally managed on the last day of our stay to access chat and explained the situation ( three times to three different chat staff during the same chat as the it kept logging me off). I was told no upgrades were available as there were no seats but to search the web myself. This is not only a cop out and no way to deal with elderly people but also not actually true as there were over ten empty seats to be seen in business class when we finally received an upgrade offer at check in. These empty seats cannot all have reappeared in the 18 hours before take-off. It appears simply a way to make sure the chat operators didn’t enter into any negotiations about free upgrades or concessionary rates. As I was told there were no seats in business class (although in fact clearly there were) and knowing our health was frail and that also I had to be back at work in a responsible position with patients' well-being depending on my decision making, on the following Monday, I asked whether we could at least get lounge pass so we could rest. Not so. I was simply told to look on the web, understand the various links and buy one. How is this even a chat service? I noted in Doha when we struggled to the Oryx lounge it was quite literally empty of travelers and was informed it would cost us $150 dollars to even sit quietly in the lounge and rest. What is it being saved for? Are the snacks simply left out to go bad? How could it not at least be used as a complementary compensatio
reviews.author: hilary k

reviews.title: Nightmare flight and rude ground staff
reviews.text: Worst flight Ive ever experienced. Flight was stuck on the tarmac in Doha for 4.5hrs unable to take off due to repeated technical problems. We were given no information, only two drinks of water, and no food during this time, parents with young children given no assistance. Passengers said we didn’t feel safe flying due to technical issues and eventually they offloaded everyone from the flight. However it was chaos in the airport, we were not told where to go, how to get the next flight, and the male ground staff were incredibly rude to a group of female passengers and made us go through security twice again. Then we eventually arrive in Melbourne 7hrs late and were told that Qatar airlines would not allow anyone to use the smart gates. Hence we then had to endure an enormous queue to get through passport control. I will not use this airline again.

reviews.title: Worst Qatar

When he informed me that there was a special seat for the infant, I was surprised when boarding the plane that there was no seat. When asked about the yacht, one of the employees came. He informed me that he wanted to cancel the special tickets, as I carried the infant for 17 hours. They do not have sufficient experience in the field of passenger service. They do not have any humanity, whether collecting money at any cost or not

reviews.title: Poor service at Qatar Airways: Baggage issue unresolved, lacking follow-up
reviews.text: I recently had a distressing experience with Qatar Airways, specifically during an incident at Sydney Airport on August 17th, 2023. This ordeal pertained to my booking and unfolded during the check-in process for my flight. The initial problem arose with an alleged excess baggage weight. In response, I diligently rearranged my luggage based on the staff's guidance, ensuring compliance with the airline's weight limits. The check-in staff confirmed that my baggage was now within the permissible range, allowing me to proceed. However, despite this reassurance, I was later denied boarding due to the same baggage issue I thought had been resolved. This situation was not only perplexing but also highly stressful, as it directly impacted my travel plans. In an attempt to address this problem, I reached out to Qatar Airways' online chat service. The staff there initially seemed responsive, promising a refund for the inconvenience caused. This promise, however, has not been fulfilled even after a month, adding to my frustration and disappointment. The lack of timely resolution and communication from Qatar Airways has significantly compounded the initial distress. The situation has been an ongoing source of inconvenience and has caused considerable disruption to my plans. Believing in amicable dispute resolution, I have been patiently awaiting a fair and prompt response from Qatar Airways. I expected the airline to process a full refund of my ticket and provide appropriate compensation for the distress and inconvenience this incident has caused. The response, or lack thereof, from Qatar Airways has been disheartening. As a customer, I expected a certain standard of service and care, which, in this case, was notably absent. The ordeal at Sydney Airport and the subsequent poor handling of the situation reflect a disappointing level of customer service. I am aware that legal processes can be lengthy and often do not benefit either party involved. Therefore, my preference has always been for a collaborative and fair resolution. However, given the ongoing lack of response, I am prepared, as advised by Fair Trading, to take this matter further, including possibly lodging a case with the NSW Civil and Administrative Tribunal (NCAT). It is important for me to share this experience so that other potential travelers are aware of the issues they might face with Qatar Airways. While I understand that errors and miscommunications can occur in any service industry, the manner in which they are addressed is crucial. The customer service experience, especially in situations of distress, is a key factor in determining the quality and reliability of an airline. In this instance, Qatar Airways has unfortunately fallen short of the expected standards. I am still hopeful for a resolution that acknowledges the inconvenience and stress caused. A prompt and fair response from Qatar Airways would be appreciated, not just for my case, but as a testament to their commitment to their customers. In conclusion, my experience with Qatar Airways has been marred by poor communication, lack of follow-up on commitments made, and a general disregard for customer service standards. This incident has significantly impacted my view of the airline, and I urge potential passengers to consider this experience when making their travel plans.
reviews.author: Mohammad Aghajouni Zadeh

reviews.text: I would like to thank qatar airways for the very very good service on all my flights, especially in economy, the helpfulness and friendliness of the entire staff as well as the onlines chat. A very heartfelt thank you. With kind regards Uwe Rapp

reviews.title: Recently flew from Perth, Western Australia to London on Qatar Airways.
reviews.text: I recently flew from Perth Western Australia to London Heathrow via Doha. Both flights were very good and i would highly recommend this airline. Stewardesses were lovely. Transferring through Doha was easy and pleasurable too. Doha has a lovely modern airport and we found it easy to locate our connecting flight. I have flown with Qatar before and never had any problems so is usually my first choice.
reviews.author: Teri P

reviews.title: Great experiance and a favorite to fly on
reviews.text: Great experience and superb service from the crew, one of the best out there always great value for money. The only thing could be the long distances in Doha for changes and the inconsistency between aircraft in the fleet with some feeling outdated and broken in comparison to others.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Extra legroom is a bit of a scam
reviews.text: First flights with Qatar. Flew Australia to London and back with a stopover in Doha. Booked and paid for the extra legroom because no premium economy on my flights. On the way out great but the two legs on the way home just normal cramped seats. Others on same flights had the same issue. No upgrades, nothing they could do but give an email to address issues when home which doesn't solve the problem. Most airlines would just upgrade the next leg to even things out. Qatar doesn't do that. It seems to be a thing they do. So be warned if you pay extra it doesn't guarantee you the extra legroom seats. Food good, service ok. Nice new planes. Entertainment system really good. Doha lovely airport but I would choose Emirates in future as they have always provided better service. Not sure how they win airline or the year so many times?
reviews.author: Traveller Mike

reviews.title: Flying private in Qatar Airways business class and getting the royal treatment. Great experience and the best staff.
reviews.text: My wife and I recently flew from Ho Chi Minh to Doha on Qatar Airways. We have been in business class many times, and we love the Qatar business class experience, this was the first time that the whole business class was basically empty. It was basically a private plane experience. This meant that the 6 bus class flight attendants were able to give us the royal treatment. We were able to speak with all of them, and got to learn so much about the intresting life they actually lead. They could not have been nicer and they were truly happy working for one of the leading airlines in the world. With air travel (especially in US and EU) devolving to just cattle car treatment, it was so nice to learn why Qatar Airways is able to uphold such a high standard. It is all about it's people, and the 6 flight attendants on our "private flight" exemplify everything that makes the airline so great. Special shout out to Misses Satinder, Alper, Prajkta, Manju (who came from the galley), Shreya, and Hyunsook. You guys are special! Keep it up. We really appreciate all you do.
reviews.author: Roshaiga

reviews.title: Always excellent
reviews.text: If possible I will always fly Qatar Airways. The planes are great with good legroom, the entertainment system is really first rate. The staff are always, smart, hard working, courteous and friendly and the food is excellent as are the selection of drinks. Really can't fault them in anyway!

reviews.text: I had the worst check in experience with Qatar airway at Atlanta international airport. The staff was not friendly at all, she count my standard backpack (It fit underneath the seat) as a carry on instead personal item, had to check in my standard carry on for $250. She refuse to check me in if I don’t pay for it. Extremely rude. Never again. See photo

reviews.text: Really, really bad. Rude flight attendants, the smallest seats I've experienced on any airlines, broken restrooms, different seat assignments than we'd been assigned, C- food. What happened? By reputation, this used to be a good airlines. I cannot recommend it to anyone after my experience. Steer clear.
reviews.author: GoingBacktoItaly

reviews.title: What a Disappointment
reviews.text: I had not flown Qatar before, and was looking forward to it. It was a disappointing experience. "The world's best airline"? Mediocre, at best. My seatmate, who has flown Qatar quite a bit, relayed that it used to be outstanding, but has gone downhill. Two restrooms, on the same side of the plane, were out, causing major lines and inconvenience (it was a 15 hour flight). The food was mediocre, at best. The flight attendants were gracious on the outgoing flight, curt on the return flight. They were down to one entree by the time they got to our row, twice. The seats on the outgoing flight were quite cramped, and I'm not a large person. I'd try Emirates, British Air or Air France next time.
reviews.author: Jan B

reviews.title: False advertising, terrible customer service
reviews.text: On two separate occasions now, Qatar Airways has refused to let me use benefits that they advertise on their website, via my status with a partner airline. On both occasions, airport staff agreed that I was entitled to those benefits, but still refused to help me. The customer service via the feedback form was laughable. One of the instances involved refusing lounge access in Colombo airport, Sri Lanka. Across 3 of the emails in this saga, I was told that I had used the lounge (on the next leg of the flight, which confirms I was entitled to access), that Qatar doesn’t have lounge facilities in Colombia (wrong country), and that I wasn’t entitled to lounge access because I don’t have status with Qatar’s program (um, do I really need to explain how airline partners work). When travelling, things don’t always go to plan. This isn’t the first time I’ve been disappointed by airline service, but it is the first time I’ve left a review, for two reasons. Firstly, I booked with Qatar to enjoy the reciprocal benefits of having platinum status with a partner airline: that was the reason I chose them, and I would have chosen a different airline if I had known they wouldn’t provide the benefits. When a business advertises specific offerings, it’s takes real arrogance to tell the customer they aren’t going to honour these promises. Secondly, the lack of accountability has been appalling, trying to find lame excuses instead of just admitting they were in the wrong. Etihad covers the same routes and keeps their word, they’ll have my future bookings.

reviews.title: Horrendous management
reviews.text: - 1PM Flight delayed, but no communication from the airlines. Discovered after visiting the airport (same with others also, I am not an exception). - 1.30 PM Initial claim is that give 45 minutes then we will know. - 2.0 PM Started check in process, when I reached the agent, they said we cannot check you in, we need to wait. I asked for alternate tickets, they said to chat with some number, which DOES NOT WORK. - 3.0 PM More chaos. - 4.0 PM Now its time for boarding for the so called delayed flight. - 4.45 PM I got a mail stating to go to Domestic terminal from international get a jet blue flight, and then to AI from JFK to BOM. - 5.0 PM I search the internet , and see multiple 9PM tickets from SFO to BOM. - 6.0 PM I call Qatar about it. Qatar claims we already made change, we cannot do it again. I tell them I wasn't consulted for the change. They say we cannot do anything . Meanwhile at 10.22 PM The flight QR738 (part of my original route) has not taken off. WTF is this bs... horrendous handling of a exceptional situation.

The flight connections were missed all the three times and no options were provided other than the option of 24 hours delay and the next day flight... taking 48 hours to reach US and claiming to do it under 24 hours is a big LIE... they should be answerable to this mode of operation and jeopardising peoples travel plans...shame qatar airways!!

reviews.title: Only one 7kg allowed for a 14 hours flight.
reviews.text: I flew with Qatar Airways several times before this trip and was allowed two carry on. Today, to my surprise, when I got to the check-in counter, I was told I was allowed only one 7kg carry-on bag. I had to scramble and figure out how to consolidate my bags. I had three laptops and had two check in two of them. This policy surprised all passengers; the check-in area was like a war zone, and everyone was trying to figure out how to manage. I saw families that ended up paying for extra bags. Qatar Airways employees didn’t even work the line to inform people of the policy change. I am very disappointed with Qatar Airways. This was a wrong decision on their behalf and will make many customers dissatisfied. I am done with Qatar Airways.

reviews.title: Promise to full refund but actually refund $100
reviews.text: Used the airline many times in the past. They have passed the initial stages times when everything was great... Its overpriced and last flight change the operator told me Sir, better get a full refund as your ticket allows it...I would not have trusted anyone else but thought OK. After chasing many times they refunded me 100 USD out of a 2000 USD ticket. An Arabic lady told me oh thats not possible will send you the balance, but they have subcontracted all refunds to an Indian team, you are lucky if you get $50 back. By now I´ve found much better alternative routes and airlines at better fares. Tickets which cost $600 return 3 years ago cost now $1800 with Qatar. Bye Qatar Airways! Good luck!! You will die of your own success, multiply the prices by four why not. Btw Doha airport is unsafely crowded its terrible, you won´t have a one sq metre for yourself. God will nothing happens there ever as the density of people in Doha is like a Sat afternoon mall x 5

reviews.title: The Worst Flight Experience Ever!
reviews.text: Had a pathetic experience with Qatar Airways. Being 7 months pregnant, booked a seat paying extra money for a seat with little bit more leg room. As i boarded the flight from Doha to my destination (Houston), I went looking for my seat and I am seeing Another person sitting on my seat. And I let the crew member know, and he brought it to the notice of the crew head who was Ms.Tshering. This crew head comes to me saying “oh the other person paid for the seat as well and he is already taken the seat so nothing they can do about it”. Me being worried about my health for a 12+ hour flight, asked them to give me another seat with extra leg room since I paid for the upgraded seat. And another crew gentleman comes in saying either I could leave the flight or sit in the empty seat they provided. Such horrible staff and service!! And I have been trying to contact the airlines for the past 9 months in order to get the refund for the seat upgrade we paid for, but ABSOLUTELY NO RESPONSE AT ALL! HORRIFIC EXPERIENCE!

reviews.author: Denis D

reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY horrendous experience
reviews.text: ABSOLUTELY horrendous experience. I was Flying CLT-JFK-DOH-DAC. My JFK-DOH leg was operated by American Airlines. The service is way way way below Qatar standard. Flight crews were rude, had no intent to serve the passengers, did not know how to behave with the passengers, and behaved as if they were forced to do some free work. WORST OF ALL: AA had an aircraft glitch at JFK, and the flight took off two hours later than scheduled. The captain did not make any effort to make up for the lost time, and arrived two and a half hours late. By that time the DOH-DAC flight departed. I was then moved to another flight with an additional 30-hours layover. My tribulations did not end there: I landed in Doha at 7:10 PM, and the time is now close to midnight; I haven't received my hotel voucher yet. I blame it on Qatar TOTALLY. My original flight was booked through Qatar, and because of the missed-connection, I had a new ticket issued by American Airlines. At Doha, Qatar simply declined to help me with my flights, saying that the ticket is issued by AA. That is simply OUTRAGEOUS and UNACCEPTABLE. Qatar is totally liable for my ticket, and I demand compensation. Just a few days ago, my husband needed to change one leg of his flight to DAC by two days; Qatar charged him USD 3,300 for change fee. Why not Qatar pay for all my troubles? My warning, DO NOT FLY QATAR, if you find that the longer leg of your journey is covered by another OneWorld Airlines. Qatar will simply shrug off its responsibility, and make you deal with all the troubles. AVOID Flying Qatar at ALL COSTS if you have multiple connections and the longest leg of your journey is operated by a partner Airlines. If you have the first leg of your flight operated by a Partner Airline then the connecting flight is operated by Qatar, DO NOT BUY the ticket from QATAR, try Emirates or Turkish. I wish I would have recorded the ordeals all my fellow passengers went through.
reviews.author: Mesbah U

reviews.title: QA   TAR
reviews.text: Check in was smooth both the connecting flights started a little late but reached the destination in time . We had bought the tickets/seats with extra leg space and that meant extra arm space which made watching tv/playing games difficult since tv was not at on arms length .Tv was fixed on wall in front.Food so so no butter was served neither at breakfast nor at lunch time ,,deficient? Back bathroom clogged ??
reviews.author: SOQ2010

reviews.title: The Q suite is fantastic
reviews.text: I have just flown from Doha to Melbourne in Qatar airways Q suite. It is deserving of the award of the worlds best business class as the experience was fantastic. All the suites are very private so it doesn’t really matter where you sit. Being able to close the door giving you your own space set it apart from its competitors. I have no idea who was sitting near me as I never saw any of my fellow passengers. This may not be for you if you like socialising in the bar that Emirates have on board but I have recently flown with Etihad, Qantas and Emirates and in business class Qatar is definitely the best. The food was excellent and option to eat what you wanted, when you wanted made it feel a more personal service. Presentation and quality of the meals service was great. The pyjamas and slippers were a nice touch and comfortable mattress, pillow, blanket and ear plugs gave you the best chance of having a few hours sleep. All of the crew were friendly, professional and attentive. Quality of entertainment was also very good. It was a great flight which felt luxurious. My first experience of Q suite was fantastic and the 13 hours from Doha to Melbourne for once went very quickly.

reviews.title: Flights & Staff are great, Website is the WORST!
reviews.text: We have flown Qatar a number of times but their website and App are really really bad! We wanted to confirm our seats online but both the App and Website (which is really really slow) didn't allow us to book our seats to ensure we are all grouped together. We've tried on three different devices, different browsers and cleared the Cookies but nope, nothing works. So now we run the risk of having our family split on different seats for an 11hr flight. I think Ive tried over a dozen times but get the same error every time. This happened the last time we flew with Qatar so not sure we'll use them again if they can't confirm seats!

reviews.title: Terrible airlines
reviews.text: We have been parked due to a delay for over 1 hour now. Reason for the delay was they’re still getting all the luggage on the plane. Terrible airlines definitely not the first time this has happened to me. Last time I booked a business class ticket and had my flight delayed 6 hours, asked for a refund and never got it. Im not sure who is rating these airlines but they are definitely taking bribes as this has been one of the worst experiences of my life. Stuck inside a cabin for over 2 hours which matches the temperature of a sauna. I highly recommend everyone stays away from qatar airways and instead give Lufthansa/Turkish a try instead.
reviews.author: Karim A

reviews.title: Excellent customer service in helping a sick passenger
reviews.text: I am nineteen and I was returning home after studying abroad. On my long 14 hour flight from Doha to Philadelphia I had the misfortune of becoming sick on the plane. It was just a very unfortunate situation, I felt terrible and it probably wasn't very much fun for everyone around me either but all of the Qatar Airways staff was absolutely wonderful and helpful for me. The flight attendants were very professional and followed the medical procedures to get the right medications and treatment for me, and they were also very kind. They checked in on me a lot, and also gave me a change of clothes. So even through it was a bad situation I am really grateful to how the Qatar Airways staff managed it. And also I am not sure that they will ever see this but I also want to thank the people sitting next to me. It was a man and a woman from the south of India, and they were just such wonderful and kind people. Basically the man moved his seat so I could lie down and the woman was patting my face with a wet cloth even though I was a total stranger, and being able to sleep like that there was probably the only reason I survived the flight. So thank you so much for your kindness, I wish there were more people like you in the world.
reviews.author: Ryley O

reviews.title: Unexpected Service Experience with Qatar Airways
reviews.text: I recently had an experience with Qatar Airways that I feel compelled to share, in the hope that it might help future passengers navigate their customer service system more effectively. I had a flight scheduled from Dubai to Orlando on Monday, June 19, 2023, and decided to change it to Saturday, June 17, 2023. Upon attempting to make the change on Qatar's website, I was directed to an online chat with a representative named Fred. Initially, Fred quoted a fare difference of $719 for two tickets, inclusive of all costs, later adjusting this to $790, which I found acceptable. My primary issue arose when discussing seating arrangements. Given that my original bookings were in First and Business Class, I expected a similar arrangement in the revised schedule. Fred assured me this would be the case, but post-payment, he stated that he was unable to assign us seats because the flight was the next day and suggested that we handle the seating at the gate. As a seasoned traveler, I am well aware that gate assignments often result in less-than-ideal seating. This reversal of assurance, in my opinion, mirrors a bait-and-switch tactic and leaves us facing the prospect of disjointed travel, potentially in separate middle seats, a far cry from the comfort we had initially booked and anticipated after spending over $10,000. I am quite disappointed with this service from Qatar Airways, an airline that is globally acclaimed and has been hailed as superior to others like Delta, American, and Southwest. This incident has compelled me to reconsider these perceptions and consider whether the service quality at Qatar Airways truly surpasses that of its counterparts. My advice to fellow travelers is to be vigilant when interacting with Qatar's customer service and make sure you have a clear understanding and assurance of all changes before proceeding with payment. I am hopeful that this instance is an outlier in Qatar Airways' usually commendable service and that they will rectify the situation promptly. My rating today is influenced by this experience and I am hopeful for a resolution that can change this review to a more positive one, reflective of the world-class airline Qatar is reputed to be.
reviews.author: James Fletcher

reviews.title: Worst experience at a hefty price
reviews.text: Although on Business class, the seat experience was worse, even than economy. Too narrow for an average person and absolutely unacceptable when flat-bed. You have to squeeze your feet in a small hole in the front seat, unable to move your legs to any direction. If you are looking for an expensive way to find out how it would feel like to be lying in a coffin, this is your best bet. As this is not enough, onboard wifi was an odyssey to connect to but also was too "cheap" to be asked for 10 USD charge for having unlimited wifi, after paying thousands for this... business class "experience". Avoid Qatar at all costs!
reviews.author: tom mal

reviews.title: Reviewing from Doha Airport
reviews.text: Travelled with qatar airways on a long journey with family they booked oryx lounge for us as a part of ticket deal because my other option was emirates which didn't had that long layover. We availed the facility on our first flight but on the return journey. When we reached oryx lounge they said that complementary lounge access policy has changed so now we have to pay for the lounge access, the travel agent emailed me the confirmation from qatar airways sales and spca representative mentioning the facility booked for the both legs of the journey, which the oryx lounge at doha Airport didn't consider at all. It is highly probable that you book tickets with 25kg listed baggage in Jan and in June when you reach airport with 20kg they may say that their policy has been changed now pay for 5kg extra baggage, you would show booking tickets etc and they will keep responding the same, dishonoring their own emails and letterheads. Or there can be scenario that you buy ticket from them and 2 months later when you show up at airport they may say, you have the ticket but we are not flying today, it's policy change, and so we cannot refund. Ridiculous isn't it. Highly non professional and irresponsible. I have asked them now to confirm and email me the cancelation so I can go for legal action against them, which I am still waiting.
reviews.author: Najeeb H

reviews.title: awful experience on long haul flights
reviews.text: This is a 16.5 hour long haul flight for which I had prepaid extra to book a premium aisle seat for myself. I had the worst experience on this flight. I had paid in advance an extra amount for the premium aisle seating for the long 16.5 haul from Doha to LAX since I suffer from knee issues. When I arrived at my aisle seat, there was a woman already seated there who asked me if she could take my seat since she was wearing a small knee brace. I reached out to the flight attendants for help in either placing me or the woman in a different aisle seat since I also was suffering from knee issues, but their response was that one of them told me to simply "ignore" the woman and claim my seat which was harsh considering there were several seats in the front of the plane which they could have made available to her. I went ahead and gave the woman access to my aisle seat and sat in HER middle seat and once again asked the flight attendants to be relocated, really hoping they would be helpful. they say one kind turn begets another, but not in this case! Their response was to say they will check with a 'supervisor' and then they never got back to me. It is horrid that I as a paying customer who prepaid in advance for an aisle seat and had the goodness of heart to sacrifice my seat for a fellow passenger while the airplane crew was unwilling to help me or her in any way. 16.5 hrs in the middle seat with a bad knee was torture for me especially after having planned in advance and paid in advance for seat selection and inspite of that being put in this crappy situation. Awful, unethical airline with crappy, unprofessional staff
reviews.author: RN_712

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: Hamad airport when we waiting next flight somebody open our luggage and they stole our staff 1-2 important thing one of them new phone. When we take it our luggage another one damaged it probably they use the force for open i think ! Baggage service they change our luggage but after 40 minutes wait for luggage and 30 minutes for new luggage we need hurry and we didnt understand another one is open ! When we understand opened and stole something we report it everywhere ! After 2 months they just say phone and other thing if you carry your luggage we our not response ! Just because you're not responsible doesn't mean you can open our suitcases and take valuables from it and employ the thieves.
reviews.author: Gençay D

reviews.title: Be careful when you book seats in advance and want to change your return flight
reviews.text: Apparently I booked a changeable ticket In October 2022, and in May this year decided I wanted to stay longer. The ticket already cost me close to $11,000 AUD and they said I had to pay $2300 (AUD) to just change the return flight. Apparently there are six yes (6) different classes of business class fares, and found out they only allocate 2-3 seats per aircraft for these six different fare types. Good luck getting one even if you book way ahead.
reviews.author: Sally H

reviews.title: Q Suites are definately the best product
reviews.text: We flew Q Suites on both legs from LHR-DOH and DOH-BNE and each time was an excellent experience, being sat in the middle of the aircraft, the walls of the quad were able to be dropped so the 3 of us were able to see and chat to each other, with doors blocking us off from the aisles. The beds were pretty comfortable too and i got off the flight feeling really good. Service was great, with friendly crew and the food and drink onboard was certainly of restaurant standard. The Halibut was particularly notable. Q Suites has totally spoiled me for life now and i would definately look to fly them in future.
reviews.author: louisj92

reviews.title: Attendants a vomiting passenger beside
reviews.text: On 10/5/22 during COVID pandemic, flight attendants knowingly moved a sick passenger into my seat mid flight when he was originally seated beside family. The flight attendant propped two pillows touching my thighs for the sick man to lay his head beside me. I am auto immune compromised and do not appreciate my health being compromised nor given an option to subject myself to a sick passenger for 9 hours within close proximity. He vomited and coughed severely for hours in a yellow bag that said “highly infectious waste”, which further proves my health was willingly compromised by the airline. I did ask to be relocated and was positioned directly behind him. It was wildly inappropriate, hazardous and inconsiderate of the airlines for my personal safety. If he was seated with a family member originally, they should have relocated the unfamiliar third passenger seated beside them to minimize the spread of the germs, and to prevent effecting another passenger such as myself. This was handled extremely poorly by the staff. I requested to be relocated, and they moved my one seat back where I watched him for 6 hours. I was holding my breath from possible sickness but also the smell of vomit. I submitted a complaint nine ago and received a response today. I was told and I quote: “ Our records show the crew moved the customer who was not well to three vacant seats, however we appreciate and value her feedback.” My experience was completely discredited and ignored. I even submitted a photograph showing the hazard bag in my aisle that matched the tickets on my seat! I didn’t receive a single apology or any accountability on their behalf. The worst experience followed by the worst customer service. They have zero regard for our health or satisfaction. This was flight QR 739
reviews.author: Autunb

reviews.title: Flying to Kathmandu from San Francisco, California
reviews.text: My trip started in San Francisco, California. I was going to visit a young beautiful lady with whom I had been talking to for past nine months. First I got to the check-in counter at San Francisco Airport. Most of the people helping me were nice. But there was this woman who was wearing the full costume and a small cap, and looked like a Qatar person, or Indian, and she was very rude and obnoxious. I asked if I could get a complimentary upgrade or pay for one. She said even if she could, she would not upgrade me unless I pay $2514.00 dollars. I found her response to be very rude. I was very offended by her reactions, and her obvious rudeness. I upgraded to Business at the gate and paid the $2514.00. My flight from Doha to Kathmandu was already upgraded to business class. But in Doha they would not give me a hotel room even though I was business class traveler. They gave me such a heart ache, The layover in Doha was 15 hours each way. Upon arrival I was told by Qatar airline representative that I wasn't going to get a free layover hotel room. It was really frustrating. I will never fly with these camel jockey's again. Who do they think they are? I hated my trip and these stingy people, QATAR you are a bunch of cheap idiots who sh.ould go .
reviews.author: Mike S

reviews.title: Terrible ground staff and bad customer service.
reviews.text: Booked my tickets through an agent. Went to the airport 3 hours before my flight. Fainted at the airport and got sent to A&E. Qatar staff on ground told me that they can't touch agency tickets but they would leave a note in the system. Ground staff didn't let me board because I fainted earlier and the time to medically check me wouldn't be in time for the flight. Contacted Qatar afterwards with regards to my situation as further attempts at rebooking imposed a no-show penalty. The first time I contacted Qatar, I get a response that my no-show charge can be waived off by my agency. My agency replied that the no-show charge is still in the system. The 2nd time I contacted Qatar, they asserted that I am not liable to waive my no-show penalty. I did show up to my flight but I was physically not able to board the flight. However, that was insufficient as I was told that the no-show penalty can only be waived in situations such as immediate death or terminal illness. I showed up and got refused boarding, got no-show penalty for rebooking, and received mixed inconsistent messages from different staff members from the same company. Would not recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Royson L

reviews.title: Outrageous! Avoid at all costs!!!
reviews.text: I was involuntarily denied boarding due to having a bag (personal item in dimensions given on their website with no particular weight specified) along with 7kg hand bag and their employee on boarding gate deemed it to be too heavy without even checking the weight until 15 minutes later when she did it in less than a second and claimed it was 11 kgs more???? What am I, a pulling donkey bringing rocks in my ladies hand bag??? It was just 2 kg more and I wanted to pay for the difference as she asked me to. So I've tried to pay. She deliberately asked for cash, took it in her hands, counted it twice (which took much of a time), than declined it saying their company doesn't allow cash payments (why did she even ask for cash if company isn't accepting it), gave it back to me, didn't give me enough time to pay by card and was extremely rude to me and few other passengers yelling, treating us as garbage. No other employee wanted to even talk to me or answer any question, nor they offered me any other solution aside from paying even though I asked for my bag to be put in cargo and when I wanted to pay she did everything possible to postpone the process until it was too late to board. Customer service dragged the case for months saying they're sorry, making me repeat my complaint and promising they will make it right. After months of waiting for their response, I got their email saying that it was my fault that I didn't want to board the plane or refused to give my bag to be put in cargo of the plane?! Really????? So, no solution, no new ticket, no money back. They stole my money, my time and portrayed me as being an idiot who payed good money for the ticket and didn't want to board the plane or pay or give bag to be put in cargo?! Never ever will I use Qatar service again. And nor should you!
reviews.author: Angry Aussie

reviews.title: Scam company
reviews.text: My flight was delayed in LHR which I missed my connecting flight. It caused me lots of issues. Its been 6 months asking for compensation which I am entitled. Few emails and chats still nothing. Now I have to use solicitors to make a claim which half of my claim will be taken as fee. This airline has enough customer and they don't care. No wonder why airbus refuse to fix the issue of aircraft for qatar air. Rules clearly says I am entitled to compensation which I asked for it. Qatar air ignored me. Qatar air claim to be best. Please stop spending money on bribe to prove the best airline. payout customer their compensation. I hope someone will soon pull out smoke screen behind the best airline just like world cup hosted in qatar full of corruption.
reviews.author: GREEN A

reviews.title: Denied Passenger Assistance because I’m too “normal” for an autistic person
reviews.text: I just made what should have been a routine phone call to add Passenger Assistance to my booking. I booked via Booking.com and couldn’t find anywhere to add this bit. However… A manager at Qatar Airlines has just told me that “if the check in staff think you’re autistic at check in then you will need a certificate to fly”. When I pointed out autism can’t be seen, he said “if you are normal then Passenger Services isn’t a service intended for you” 😱😱😱 So I am now in a position where because I don’t need a wheelchair and I won’t present at check in with anything “visible” to indicate my autism, I cannot be accompanied through a giant airport for a long haul trip, as a person with sensory issues and who gets lost, overwhelmed and vulnerable in airports. Even if I did I would need some kind of letter. Despite being a professional, travelling all the time, being insured… I am horrified this company is trading in the UK in 2023 and doesn’t have a basic understanding of customer service or disability rights. I am not saying other airlines are amazing. Generally the passenger services companies recruit one or two people who “get it” and they save the trip. It is very hit and miss. But this level of ignorance surpasses most crass experiences I’ve had
reviews.author: PlsTripResponsibly
